Monetta Financial Services Cut Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $4.51 Million as Stock Price Rose; Fortuna Silver Mines (FSM) Market Value Rose While Global X Management Co Increased Its Stake
June 15, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Monetta Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 57.45% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Monetta Financial Services Inc sold 27,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 20,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.36 million, down from 47,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Monetta Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $927.88 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.06% or $2.02 during the last trading session, reaching $188.78. About 24.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
